ai_summary: AAKASH EXPLORATION SERVICES LIMITED announced the resignation of Mr. Krunal Pravin Haria, a Whole Time Director and Key Managerial Personnel, citing personal reasons and other professional commitments. A significant red flag is the material inconsistency in the effective date: the company's intimation states July 30, 2026, while the enclosed resignation letter from Mr. Haria explicitly states July 30, 2027. This discrepancy requires immediate clarification to ensure accurate disclosure regarding leadership transitions.
